title: pt13528: An open-source Python library for proficiency testing statistics according to ISO 13528
description: Framework-independent Python implementation of the statistical methods of ISO 13528:2022 with Amd 1:2026 (assigned value, standard deviation for proficiency assessment, performance scores, homogeneity and stability checks, robust estimators, result record), verified against the worked examples of Annex E of the standard.
